evidence: scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the template: [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6 polish=0.2 visual=0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05; every name has a directory (tests/gates/render, tests/gates/constraints, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}). tomllib parse of all five judge.toml: every [judge] has judge="claude-code" fallback, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md", no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight keys; every file declares the playwright stdio MCP server (playwright-mcp --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:24-28 declares name="verifier", command=/usr/local/bin/python3, args=["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]; test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after heredoc+sed substitution and chmod 755 (test.sh is identical to the template), and rewardkit agents.py:66 applies os.path.expandvars to MCP args. Gates: aggregation=all_pass, one binary criterion each (authenticated_render w1.0; server_backed_local_application w1.0). Scored: functional weighted_mean 17 binary criteria, ids unique, weights 1.5-3.0 (sum 34); polish weighted_mean 5 binary w1.0; visual weighted_mean 4 likert points=5 w2/2/1/1. No empty descriptions, no unknown criterion keys. All five prompt.md files contain {criteria} and {app_context} (test.sh:196-201 substitutes app_context; rewardkit runner.py requires {criteria}) and open localhost:3000. tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py identical to template; score.py reads ../scoring.toml from tests/tools. Only template deviation: functional mode="individual", timeout=520 (comment lines 7-12 records lead authorization relayed 8 Oct 2026). rewardkit 0.1.7 models.py:142 JudgeMode=Literal["batched","individual"]; judges.py:467-490 runs agent criteria sequentially in file order, and persistence is the last [[criterion]] (functional judge.toml:235), matching the single-use restart_app marker (restart_mcp.py:29-31) and prompt.md:57-64 'No other criterion calls restart_app'. Actual-load check: rewardkit.runner.discover() on the frozen /tests/gates and /tests/scored inside cw-editor-verifier:current (rewardkit 0.1.7, same pin as tests/Dockerfile) loaded all five as AgentJudge: constraints/render batched 600 all_pass 1 criterion; functional individual 520 with playwright+verifier servers, 17 criteria weighted_mean; polish batched 900 5 criteria; visual batched 900 4 likert points=5 criteria. Risk=true because no full configured judge run (gates+scored with real MCP servers, restart helper and score.py) exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'), the private check-rubric-schema.py/check-scoring-policy.py were not executed, and individual mode is a template deviation whose per-criterion serial workload (17x520+900+900=10640 s of 11100) is unmeasured (row 11's concern). Counterexample probes: (a) broken app passing via wiring - none found; gates are all_pass binary and score.py zeroes on gate failure or functional<=0.05. (b) conforming app failing via wiring - possible only if an earlier individual-mode functional session ignores the prompt and calls restart_app, consuming the single-use marker so persistence gets 'already used'; mitigated by prompt.md:9 and :57-64, and not a structural defect.
